evidence.reason: The finding alleged that AnalyzeFailureSetSchema's .strict() object rejects the optional vitest FailureSet keys (numTotalTests, advisories, numPassedTests, numPassed, numSkippedTests, numPendingTests, numTodoTests) before analyze.collectFailures/analyze.clusterErrors can run. The pinned tip already mirrors those keys: lines 154-164 of src/ops/analyze/registry.ts add each optional field with .exactOptional() (integer/nonnegative on the count fields), with a comment explicitly stating they mirror the vitest adapter's FailureSetSchema so a gates-produced set is accepted at this boundary. This matches the suggested fix, so the defect no longer exists.
